neighbours.label: in a finding that one group of people is more or less likely (or prone) to something than another group, the comparison group named right after 'than' or 'as'
fire: The study found that smokers were three times more likely to develop lung disease than nonsmokers.
Children raised in rural areas were less prone to allergies than children raised in cities.
Night-shift nurses were twice as likely to report sleep problems as nurses working day shifts.
According to the survey, older drivers are less likely to speed than teenage drivers.
Researchers reported that left-handed people were slightly more prone to migraines than right-handed people.
Women in the trial were more likely to experience side effects from the drug than men.
Students who skipped breakfast were more likely to feel tired in class than their classmates who ate in the morning.
Veterans were found to be nearly twice as likely to develop hearing loss as civilians of the same age.
quiet: The easiest way—no matter that it’s still difficult—to check if life could exist in supercritical carbon dioxide naturally is to check the oceans at about a kilometer’s depth, where pressures are sufficient to entertain pockets of supercritical fluids.
With the help of a spectrometer, they were able to differentiate the various laser wavelengths generated in the material and localize them separately from one another.
The study found that smokers were at high risk of developing lung disease over a ten-year period.
Children raised in rural areas often have fewer allergies, the doctor said during the interview.
Night-shift nurses frequently report sleep problems, especially during their first year on the job.
According to the survey, older drivers tend to speed less on highways now than they did a decade ago.
Researchers reported that left-handed people sometimes experience migraines, though the cause is unclear.
Women in the trial experienced several side effects from the drug, mostly mild headaches.
